claims.quote: After registration, prepare the fictional supporting copy. This action does not require the application form to be prepared first. The copy is required for submission.
After registration, prepare the fictional completed application form. This action does not require the supporting copy to be prepared first. The form is required for submission.

Register the fictional application before preparing its two required items. Registration, preparation and submission each have a fictional fee of LKR 0. After registration, preparing the form and preparing the supporting copy may proceed independently, in either order or concurrently. Both must be completed before submission.

Submit the fictional application only after both preparation actions are complete. Include the fictional completed application form and the fictional supporting copy. Completing only one preparation action is insufficient.

phases.why_grouped: Registration is the common prerequisite for the preparation work areas.
The form and applicable copy work belong to preparation; alternatives remain together and independence comes only from verified edges.
Submission joins the required preparation work and documents.
